QuestInfo.name: An Expensive Acquisition
QuestInfo.0: Check to see if the #o9001047# is still working.
QuestInfo.1: The #o9001047# malfunctioned and attacked you! Its warranty must have expired. You'd better destroy it before it hurts someone else!
QuestInfo.2: You destroyed the #o9001047# and, sure enough, the warranty was expired.

0.0: Wait a minute. I left a really nasty #rGuardioso#k here. I wonder if it still works. It was supposed to last a thousand years, but things don't seem to be holding up to this new world.
0.1: I remember it being a real piece of work. I'd hate to have to fight it just to get inside, but I need to get those journals.

1.0: I can't believe that thing was broken! And the warranty expired YESTERDAY, I can't even get it replaced! That company probably doesn't even exist anymore! I have had the worst luck since I came back...
